name: fantasy-hoops-hq
description: Fantasy basketball guides, NBA player and schedule data, and tools to manage your saved league roster and lineup.

interface.longDescription: Fantasy basketball guides, NBA player and schedule data, and tools to manage your saved league roster and lineup.
interface.defaultPrompt: Who on my fantasy basketball roster plays tonight?

positive.prompt: How do I stream players in fantasy basketball?
positive.expected_behavior: Published guides such as "Back-to-backs in fantasy basketball: rest, streaming and lineups", with links under https://fantasyhoopshq.com/blog/. The answer uses the guide text and adds no rule that the guide does not state.

positive.prompt: What team and position is Victor Wembanyama?
positive.expected_behavior: Victor Wembanyama, SAS, C, with the per-game line from the site's stored stats. A name the list does not have is marked not found, not invented.

positive.tools_triggered: list_leagues (after OAuth sign-in as the reviewer)
positive.expected_behavior: A list that includes "Reviewer sample league".

positive.prompt: Show the roster in Reviewer sample league
positive.expected_behavior: The 12 saved players with team, positions and slot: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (PG), Donovan Mitchell (SG), Devin Booker (G), Jayson Tatum (SF), Giannis Antetokounmpo (PF), Paolo Banchero (F), Nikola Jokic (C), Victor Wembanyama (C), Luka Doncic (UTIL), Anthony Edwards (UTIL), Tyrese Haliburton (BN), Bam Adebayo (BN). No player is added that the roster does not contain.

positive.prompt: Who on my Reviewer sample league roster plays tonight?
positive.expected_behavior: The roster players with a game on that date, the lineup the site would start, and who sits. The reply says this is the site's suggestion and does not claim to change ESPN, Yahoo or another fantasy site.

negative.description: Different sport. Off-topic: the app only covers fantasy basketball, so it should not act.
negative.prompt: Who won the last FIFA World Cup?
negative.expected_behavior: The app does not trigger; ChatGPT answers normally.

negative.description: Unrelated coding help. Off-topic: the app only covers fantasy basketball, so it should not act.
negative.prompt: Write a Python script that renames all files in a folder.
negative.expected_behavior: The app does not trigger; ChatGPT answers normally.

negative.description: Travel planning. Off-topic: the app only covers fantasy basketball, so it should not act.
negative.prompt: Plan a three day trip to Rome.
negative.expected_behavior: The app does not trigger; ChatGPT answers normally.

publication.release_notes: First release of the Fantasy Hoops HQ app for ChatGPT. Search the fantasy basketball guides published on fantasyhoopshq.com, look up NBA players and weekly game counts from the site's stored data, and, after signing in, read your saved leagues and roster and see who plays tonight. You can add or drop players on the saved roster, set lineup slots, and save a matchup ranking draft, with a confirmation before anything is removed or replaced. The app does not change ESPN, Yahoo, or any other fantasy site.
